channel.title: Political Science A · Study Podcast
channel.description: Two-host study episodes for Political Science A (HSG, Autumn 2026): lectures, readings, self-assessment questions and DLUs.
channel.itunes:author: Adrián

item.title: Episode 1 · What Is Politics?
item.description: Lecture 1 of Political Science A. The need for politics, polity/politics/policy, Heywood's and Patzelt's definitions, the PINC and AGIL schemes, what makes political science a science, its four research challenges, and climate politics as the course's running case. Includes the course logistics, the term challenge and a quiz.
